Official_registry_or_authority: Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA) - Higher Education Institutions
Role: National official HEI directory; revoked/suspended status is explicitly marked for affected institutions.
Cutoff_support: Current official registry used as retrospective eligibility corroboration; selected-case cutoff status remains anchored to the preserved pre-outcome selection record unless a dated source is separately listed.

Official_registry_or_authority: Council of Universities Affairs - Public universities
Role: Official public-university list with founding information.
Cutoff_support: Official regulator list; used to corroborate selected public HEIs and founding-order evidence.

Official_registry_or_authority: Council of Universities Affairs - Private universities and colleges
Role: Official private-university/college list with founding information.
Cutoff_support: Official regulator list; used to corroborate selected private HEIs and founding-order evidence.

Official_registry_or_authority: Ministry of Education and Higher Education - Higher Education in Qatar
Role: Official national list separating public HEIs, Qatar Foundation universities, private HEIs, and security/military HEIs.
Cutoff_support: Official ministry list; directly supports eligibility of selected civilian public, Qatar Foundation/private, and applied/specialized HEIs.

Official_registry_or_authority: Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation - Government Higher Education institutions
Role: Official government-HEI list; includes SQU, UTAS and College of Sharia Sciences.
Cutoff_support: Official ministry list; retrospective corroboration of selected public HEIs.

Official_registry_or_authority: Ministry of Higher Education - Private Universities & Colleges
Role: Official ministry list of private universities and colleges; includes Sohar, Majan, Modern College of Business and Science, and Muscat College.
Cutoff_support: Official ministry list; retrospective corroboration of selected private HEIs.

Official_registry_or_authority: Education and Training Quality Authority (BQA) - Higher Education Reports
Role: Official HE institutional listing/review source with listing and active-status fields.
Cutoff_support: Official BQA source; dated pre-cutoff evidence is used where available, including Kingdom University and other selected HEIs.

Official_registry_or_authority: Ministry of Higher Education - entities affiliated with the Minister
Role: Official ministry page listing Kuwait University, Abdullah Al-Salem University and Kuwait Academy of Arts, among affiliated entities.
Cutoff_support: Official ministry source; retrospective corroboration of selected public HEIs.

Official_registry_or_authority: State of Kuwait Government Online - Civil Universities List
Role: Official government list of private/civil universities and colleges; includes AUK, GUST, AOU-Kuwait and Australian College/University lineage.
Cutoff_support: Page dated 15 July 2026 in the indexed English version, before the 23 July cutoff; direct pre-cutoff support for the selected private/civil institutions.

Official_registry_or_authority: Public Authority for Applied Education and Training (PAAET)
Role: Official PAAET portal listing its applied colleges and institutes.
Cutoff_support: Official institution source; retrospective corroboration of PAAET as a public applied higher-education entity.
